name: sweet-spot
description: Hands a long session over, to a fresh one or by compacting, before the context gets too big

threshold.title: Handoff threshold (tokens)
threshold.description: Context size at which the session is handed over to a fresh one, once the work at hand is done. Values below 130000 are rejected: a fresh session starts near that size and would hand over again at once.

dry_run.title: Dry run
dry_run.description: Only say that a handoff would happen, and do nothing. Turn it on to watch what the mod would do before it acts.

min_gap_minutes.title: Minimum gap after a handoff (minutes)
min_gap_minutes.description: Least time between one handoff and the next. 0 for no time gap.

min_gap_turns.title: Minimum gap after a handoff (turns)
min_gap_turns.description: Least number of turns between one handoff and the next. 0 for no turn gap.

later_tokens.title: Later, with no number (tokens)
later_tokens.description: How far /sweet-spot later moves the next handover back when you give it no number: the mod hands over once the context has grown this many tokens past where it was.

handoff_method.title: Handoff method
handoff_method.description: How the session is handed over. internal-handoff: Claude writes a handoff and the mod starts a fresh session with it. builtin-compact: Claude Code's own /compact, the session stays. external-command: your own command writes the handoff (advanced, see Handoff command).

handoff_fallback.title: Fallback method
handoff_fallback.description: Used when the main method fails before it changed the session. internal-handoff, builtin-compact, external-command: as in Handoff method. none: no second try; the mod says why. Same as the main method: no fallback.

handoff_command.title: Handoff command
handoff_command.description: Only used with external-command (advanced). Name of your own handoff command, as the command list shows it, without the slash.
